title: UX: Improve admin onboarding topic suggestions
body:
**Previously**, onboarding asked admins to invite collaborators before posting and offered generic conversation starters without recording which option completed the step.

**In this update**, posting comes before invites, with two Staff planning prompts, the existing General introduction, a blank General option, and the selected option recorded in the staff action log details.

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |

| ![Previous topic suggestions](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6fc37007-b7c8-402e-ba27-d762d5461945) | ![Updated topic suggestions and category badges](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d5b132d8-6e34-4cc8-b29b-f4f2ec8512d1) |
